## What's changed

This is a minor fix so i will keep old changelog.

- [feat: enable SQLite batch atomic writes and preserve fdatasync](https://github.com/qwq233/OhMyKeymint/commit/45d289107ae45da11ca65266ada38bcec4105fd1)
- [fix(injector): route isolated callers by host application](https://github.com/qwq233/OhMyKeymint/commit/7ef41b037e1ac0554ec6b6d1c38f6db457b00684)
- [fix(injector): validate Binder receivers before OMK execution](https://github.com/qwq233/OhMyKeymint/commit/e6844a4648c9525ca7a49fffca00991ff5720e22)

These commit might fix some issue and align AOSP behavior.

### 1.2.5 changes

This release updates the KeyMint and Keystore implementation to Android 17, including KeyMint v5 and ML-DSA support on the TEE path. Compatibility with older Android releases has also been improved through corrected transaction layouts and attestation application-ID resolution. VINTF manifest assembly now follows libvintf more closely, and StrongBox is only exposed when the corresponding system KeyMint HAL is present.

The injector now backs its OMK security-level and operation handles with native Binder objects, and the hooking backend has switched from `lsplt-rs` to `omhook`. Binder replies, interface metadata, one-way transactions, empty key descriptors, and operation cleanup have been corrected. Hook initialization failures no longer panic inside `keystore2`. The injected payload also connects to OMK RPC directly, with separate authentication-token and lifecycle sessions and cached connections to reduce contention and request overhead.

Scoop routing now consistently follows the current caller, filter decision, and per-method intercept settings. Historical `KEY_ID` or `GRANT` ownership no longer overrides that decision, and disabled methods remain on System. OMK business errors are returned unchanged, while transport and reply-boundary failures are normalized to AOSP-compatible errors such as `SYSTEM_ERROR` instead of being hidden by a successful System reply.

Key derivation and compatibility with legacy OMK key and super-key formats were corrected. Stored legacy OS-version metadata is migrated to AOSP encoding, and lowering configured OS or patch levels no longer rejects existing OMK keys solely for carrying newer values. Failed localization discards only the affected mirrored auth token, and the existing `force_skip_system_biometric_hat_verification` switch takes effect correctly.

Attestation trust settings now include independent OS, vendor, and boot patch levels. `os_version = "auto"` follows the current Android major at KeyMint startup, and automatic boot patch detection reads AVB metadata or the boot image header before property fallbacks. Patch-level-only edits can update active TAs without rebuilding them, preserving in-flight operations and per-boot state. When automatic verified-boot key or hash discovery has no usable source, the generated fallback is pinned in `config.toml` so it stays stable across restarts.

Device-ID discovery now runs on demand through the privileged Binder helper with the correct system UID and Android-version-specific telephony transactions. It retries while required services are not registered and shares the resolved snapshot between TEE and StrongBox. Single-IMEI devices, absent MEID or IMEI2, partial probe success, and explicit empty overrides are handled without invalidating unrelated attestation IDs.

Keyboxes containing only a valid EC entry are now supported; RSA-key attestations use the EC signing key and certificate chain when the RSA entry is absent. Keybox rotation only retires keys actually attested by the previous keybox. The new `main.retire_stale_keybox_bound_keys` setting can preserve those client keys when required; retirement remains enabled by default.

Valid older configurations are migrated at startup to `config.toml` version 3 and `injector.toml` version 1. Migration from unversioned or version 1 KeyMint configs resets `os_version` to `"auto"`; keep all generated `[crypto]` values unchanged. The injector is now the only runtime backend, with legacy `backend = "omk"` accepted as an alias for `"injector"`. Malformed files are no longer overwritten with defaults: an invalid KeyMint config prevents startup, an invalid injector config disables routing at startup, and failed live reloads retain the last valid configuration. Log levels now apply correctly, and logs are written under `/data/misc/keystore/omk/logs/`.

Additionally, injector and KeyMint overhead was reduced, module updates no longer create an `omkdata` symlink loop, and the daemon prefers `/system/lib64` over `/vendor/lib64` in its library search path. Dependencies were updated, formatting, Android-targeted Clippy, and `cargo-deny` checks were added to CI, and configuration and troubleshooting documentation was expanded. The project now uses the General License Agreement together with the updated Oh My Keymint License; read both before using or redistributing this release.

## Attestation

- https://github.com/qwq233/OhMyKeymint/attestations/64354332

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/qwq233/OhMyKeymint/compare/1.2.5-17b0eb6...1.2.6-9069c6c

**Bring back the old gem from Android 11.** The classic AOSP power menu on HyperOS / MIUI, with custom items, reboot entries and blur.

### Highlights
- AOSP power menu on HyperOS / MIUI
- Pick any items in any order: Recovery, Restart, Bootloader, Power off, SystemUI, Soft reboot, Emergency, Lockdown and more
- Presets *Essential 2×2* and *All-in 2×3*, 2 or 3 columns
- Optional background blur with adjustable strength
- Black glass WebUI with live preview

### Changes in v3.0.2
- The Power11 app is now installed as a regular app, so Vector/LSPosed lists it
- Plugin components disabled by AOSP Power Menu v1/v2 are taken over correctly

### Install
1. Download `Power11_v3.0.1.zip` below → KernelSU Next → Modules → Install from storage → reboot
2. Vector (or LSPosed) → Modules → enable **Power11**, scope **System UI**
3. Power11 WebUI → *Restart* SystemUI, then pick your items

Requires KernelSU Next and Android 12+. Vector/LSPosed is needed only for custom items and order: the AOSP menu itself works without it.

Upgrading from *AOSP Power Menu* v1/v2? Just install Power11: it replaces the old module and keeps your settings.

**Bring back the old gem from Android 11.** The classic AOSP power menu on HyperOS / MIUI, with custom items, reboot entries and blur.

### Highlights
- AOSP power menu on HyperOS / MIUI
- Pick any items in any order: Recovery, Restart, Bootloader, Power off, SystemUI, Soft reboot, Emergency, Lockdown and more
- Presets *Essential 2×2* and *All-in 2×3*, 2 or 3 columns
- Optional background blur with adjustable strength
- Black glass WebUI with live preview

### Changes in v3.0.2
- The Power11 app is now installed as a regular app, so Vector/LSPosed lists it
- Plugin components disabled by AOSP Power Menu v1/v2 are taken over correctly

### Install
1. Download `Power11_v3.0.1.zip` below → KernelSU Next → Modules → Install from storage → reboot
2. Vector (or LSPosed) → Modules → enable **Power11**, scope **System UI**
3. Power11 WebUI → *Restart* SystemUI, then pick your items

Requires KernelSU Next and Android 12+. Vector/LSPosed is needed only for custom items and order: the AOSP menu itself works without it.

Upgrading from *AOSP Power Menu* v1/v2? Just install Power11: it replaces the old module and keeps your settings.
stable.name: Power11 v3.0.2

<details>
  <summary> English </summary>

## ADD 

- The automatic cleaning settings page now shows the last run time; if never run/configured, it displays as empty
- Added app cleaning rule preset: WeChat (com.tencent.mm)

## UPDATE

- App splash screen reworked to follow relevant guidelines; no longer displays a custom splash on startup
- File organization no longer shows items with a count of 0
- Timed language auto-refresh interval changed to 5 minutes, fixing delayed language updates
- App code optimization: removed dead code, updated some legacy code
- Removed the useless Tab bar at the bottom of the App to improve the full-screen experience
- App storage cache cleaning no longer reports errors on failure, since most failures are simply due to the cache directory not existing
- Directory reorganization: whitelist files are no longer scattered in the config directory but placed in a dedicated directory
- The whitelist now applies to app private directories in internal storage, preventing junk and empty folders from being cleaned within them
- Custom rule cleaning now displays the total cleaned size

## FIX

- [Test] Tested fix for disappearing downloaded themes in `Xiaomi Themes` and abnormal image loading in `TIM`
- Fixed a bug where the search box in the App chooser interface merged into the status bar

</details>
<details>
  <summary> 简体中文 </summary>

## ADD 

- 自动清理设置页面现在会显示上次运行时间，如果从未运行/设置过则显示为空
- 新增软件清理规则预设: 微信/WeChat (com.tencent.mm)

## UPDATE

- App 启动屏改造，遵循相关规范，启动时不再显示自定义 Splash
- 现在文件归类不再显示归类数量为 0 的项
- Timed 语言自动更新时间改为 5 分钟，修复语言更新不及时问题
- App 代码优化，删除无效代码，修改部分老旧代码
- 删除 App 底部无用 Tab 栏，提高全面屏体验
- 现在 App 储存缓存清理失败不再报错，因为其中大多数仅因缓存目录不存在
- 目录整理：白名单文件现在不再散落于配置目录而是专有目录内
- 现在白名单对内部储存 App 私有目录生效，不会再清理其内垃圾、空文件夹
- 现在自定义规则清理会显示总清理大小

## FIX

- [Test] 测试修复 `小米主题` 下载主题消失及 `TIM` 图片加载异常问题
- 修复 App 选择界面搜索框融进状态栏的 Bug

</details>
<details>
  <summary> 正體中文 </summary>

## ADD 

- 自動清理設定頁面現在會顯示上次執行時間，如果從未執行/設定過則顯示為空
- 新增軟體清理規則預設: 微信/WeChat (com.tencent.mm)

## UPDATE

- App 啟動畫面改造，遵循相關規範，啟動時不再顯示自訂 Splash
- 現在檔案歸類不再顯示歸類數量為 0 的項目
- Timed 語言自動更新時間改為 5 分鐘，修復語言更新不及時問題
- App 程式碼最佳化，刪除無效程式碼，修改部分老舊程式碼
- 刪除 App 底部無用 Tab 欄，提高全螢幕體驗
- 現在 App 儲存快取清理失敗不再報錯，因為其中大多數僅因快取目錄不存在
- 目錄整理：白名單檔案現在不再散落於設定目錄而是專有目錄內
- 現在白名單對內部儲存 App 私有目錄生效，不會再清理其內垃圾、空資料夾
- 現在自訂規則清理會顯示總清理大小

## FIX

- [Test] 測試修復 `小米主題` 下載主題消失及 `TIM` 圖片載入異常問題
- 修復 App 選擇介面搜尋框融入狀態列的 Bug

</details>
<details>
  <summary> Русский </summary>

## ADD 

- На странице настроек автоматической очистки теперь отображается время последнего запуска; если очистка никогда не запускалась/не настраивалась, поле остаётся пустым
- Добавлен предустановленный набор правил очистки приложений: WeChat (com.tencent.mm)

## UPDATE

- Переработан экран запуска App в соответствии с рекомендациями; при запуске больше не отображается пользовательский Splash
- Классификация файлов больше не показывает элементы с количеством 0
- Интервал автоматического обновления языка в Timed изменён на 5 минут, исправлена задержка обновления языка
- Оптимизация кода App: удалён неиспользуемый код, обновлён некоторый устаревший код
- Удалена бесполезная нижняя панель Tab в App для улучшения полноэкранного опыта
- Очистка кэша хранилища App больше не сообщает об ошибке при неудаче, поскольку в большинстве случаев причина — отсутствие каталога кэша
- Реорганизация каталогов: файлы белого списка больше не разбросаны по каталогу конфигурации, а находятся в отдельном каталоге
- Белый список теперь применяется к приватным каталогам приложений во внутреннем хранилище — мусор и пустые папки внутри них больше не очищаются
- Очистка по пользовательским правилам теперь отображает общий размер очистки

## FIX

- [Test] Протестировано исправление исчезновения загруженных тем в `Xiaomi Themes` и аномальной загрузки изображений в `TIM`
- Исправлена ошибка, из-за которой строка поиска в интерфейсе выбора App сливалась со строкой состояния

</details>
<details>
  <summary> 한국어 </summary>

## ADD 

- 자동 정리 설정 페이지에 마지막 실행 시간이 표시됩니다. 한 번도 실행/설정하지 않은 경우 비어 있음으로 표시됩니다
- 앱 정리 규칙 사전 설정 추가: WeChat (com.tencent.mm)

## UPDATE

- App 시작 화면 개편, 관련 가이드라인 준수, 시작 시 커스텀 Splash를 더 이상 표시하지 않음
- 파일 분류에서 개수가 0인 항목을 더 이상 표시하지 않음
- Timed 언어 자동 업데이트 간격을 5분으로 변경, 언어 업데이트 지연 문제 수정
- App 코드 최적화: 불필요한 코드 삭제, 일부 오래된 코드 수정
- App 하단의 불필요한 Tab 바를 삭제하여 전체 화면 경험 개선
- App 저장소 캐시 정리 실패 시 더 이상 오류를 보고하지 않음. 실패의 대부분은 캐시 디렉터리가 존재하지 않기 때문임
- 디렉터리 정리: 화이트리스트 파일이 더 이상 구성 디렉터리에 흩어져 있지 않고 전용 디렉터리에 위치함
- 화이트리스트가 내부 저장소의 앱 개인 디렉터리에 적용되어, 그 안의 쓰레기 및 빈 폴더를 더 이상 정리하지 않음
- 커스텀 규칙 정리 시 총 정리 크기가 표시됨

## FIX

  <summary> English </summary>

## ADD 

- The automatic cleaning settings page now shows the last run time; if never run/configured, it displays as empty
- Added app cleaning rule preset: WeChat (com.tencent.mm)

## UPDATE

- App splash screen reworked to follow relevant guidelines; no longer displays a custom splash on startup
- File organization no longer shows items with a count of 0
- Timed language auto-refresh interval changed to 5 minutes, fixing delayed language updates
- App code optimization: removed dead code, updated some legacy code
- Removed the useless Tab bar at the bottom of the App to improve the full-screen experience
- App storage cache cleaning no longer reports errors on failure, since most failures are simply due to the cache directory not existing
- Directory reorganization: whitelist files are no longer scattered in the config directory but placed in a dedicated directory
- The whitelist now applies to app private directories in internal storage, preventing junk and empty folders from being cleaned within them
- Custom rule cleaning now displays the total cleaned size

## FIX

- [Test] Tested fix for disappearing downloaded themes in `Xiaomi Themes` and abnormal image loading in `TIM`
- Fixed a bug where the search box in the App chooser interface merged into the status bar

</details>
<details>
  <summary> 简体中文 </summary>

- 自动清理设置页面现在会显示上次运行时间，如果从未运行/设置过则显示为空

- Timed 语言自动更新时间改为 5 分钟，修复语言更新不及时问题

- 目录整理：白名单文件现在不再散落于配置目录而是专有目录内
- 现在白名单对内部储存 App 私有目录生效，不会再清理其内垃圾、空文件夹
- 现在自定义规则清理会显示总清理大小

## FIX

- [Test] 测试修复 `小米主题` 下载主题消失及 `TIM` 图片加载异常问题
- 修复 App 选择界面搜索框融进状态栏的 Bug

</details>
<details>
  <summary> 正體中文 </summary>

## ADD 

- 自動清理設定頁面現在會顯示上次執行時間，如果從未執行/設定過則顯示為空

## FIX

- [Test] 測試修復 `小米主題` 下載主題消失及 `TIM` 圖片載入異常問題
